keys.obs: database observations of the series, yield to 4 decimals; null where the source permits no display of points
keys.trend: the trend_series row of the series
keys.trend_anomaly: rows of trend_anomaly for the series, in column order; null where withheld
keys.enso: rows of enso_windows for the series (season exposure under both indices)
keys.qc: rows of qc_flags for the series; null where withheld
keys.responses: rows of response_leaf for the weather variables (tavg_mean, tmax_p95_days, precip, wet_days), in column order
keys.weather: rows of weather_todate_anomaly for the series (one per product), with the product's metrics as [value, reference, anom, z, pct_rank, n_years]
keys.weather_history: complete seasons 1981-2025 of weather_season: the season mean temperature (product best, tavg_mean) and the season rainfall (product chirps, precip) as departures from the series' own linear trend over those seasons, the detrending of the leaf fits
keys.weather_expected: per weather variable with a hierarchical slope: the harvest year of the series' predictions, the mean relative-index path (central scenario) over the months of the series' growing window and the slope times it (the expected departure this season), the months counted, and the same over the observed months alone (the departure the index so far implies)
keys.scenario_contrast: rows of scenario_contrast (method linear) for the series at relative-index values -1, 0, 1, 2 (scenario grid: percent contrast, 80 percent harvest range from the leave-one-year-out errors, probabilities of a 20 percent loss and gain, extrapolation flag) and one row (scenario central) at the central-path exposure of the prediction harvest year with the atlas's medium index_outlook prediction, the probabilities interpolated in the index, and the flag where the exposure lies outside the fitted range (DISPLAY_SPECIFICATION_2026-10-19.md)

forecast_target.record_warning: Local yield records end 2000; current applicability unassessed.
